referee_caveats_inferred: SFR of b1 depends strongly on the assumed SED (490 vs ~150 Msun/yr) and rests on a single 5 sigma ALMA flux point
ALMA imaging settings are minimal and the stated spectral resolution (40 vs 10 km/s) and continuum frequency (230 vs 288 GHz) are inconsistent in the text
The CO limit assumes a 500 km/s line width and an unspecified CO(5-4)/CO(1-0) ratio, so M(CO) is model dependent
Most conclusions rest on non-ALMA data (SINFONI, KMOS, HST, Chandra); ALMA contributes one continuum detection and limits
